Name: Salad's Pink And Purple Ducks Recolor
Author: saladcreates
Description:
Turns all ducks to pink and purple.

Requires Smapi and Content Patcher.

Download file, drag into your mods folder and it's ready to go!

Looks cute when used with [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3499?tab=description]Cute Valley[/url]﻿ and [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21531]Cotton Candy Recolor[/url]﻿ !
